raw_segments.text: The seventh article of the treaty concluded in 1791 with the Cherokees says,
The United States solemnly guaranteed to the Cherokee Nation all their lands not hereby seated.
The following article declared that if any citizen of the United States or other settler not of the
Indian race should establish himself upon the territory of the Cherokees, the United States
would withdraw their protection from that individual and give him up to be punished
as the Cherokee Nation should think fit.
